Title: Engineer - Data Analyst
Description: Company Description We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (15000+ experts across 26 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in! Job Description Role and Responsibility: Build Dashboards & Reports: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Tableau and/or Power BI that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders. Own the full lifecycle from requirements gathering to published, production-grade visualizations. Data Analysis & Storytelling: Analyze manufacturing, operational, and financial data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities. Translate findings into clear, compelling visual narratives that drive decision-making across teams. SQL & Data Exploration: Write SQL queries in Snowflake to extract, transform, and validate data for reporting. Perform ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions and support strategic initiatives. Support Data Modeling: Collaborate with data engineers to define reporting requirements and contribute to dbt model development — building or modifying staging and mart models that feed dashboards and reports. Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot data inconsistencies, ask the right questions, and deliver accurate, trustworthy reporting. Documentation & Training: Document data definitions, metric calculations, and dashboard usage guides. Provide training and support to business users to promote self-service analytics adoption. Expectation from the Candidate: Experience: 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, BI analyst, or reporting analyst role with a portfolio of dashboards and reports delivered to business stakeholders. Technical Prowess: o Strong proficiency in Tableau and/or Power BI: calculated fields, LOD expressions (Tableau), DAX measures (Power BI), parameters, dynamic filters, row-level security, and performance optimization. Working knowledge of SQL for querying Snowflake: JOINs, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and basic data transformation. Foundational understanding of dbt: ability to read and modify existing models, understand the staging/mart layer structure, and run dbt commands for testing and documentation. Familiarity with data modeling concepts: star schemas, fact/dimension tables, and how they translate into efficient dashboard data sources. Basic Python skills for data wrangling, automation, or extending analytics workflows (pandas, notebooks). Qualifications Must have skills: Power BI (Strong), Tableau (Strong) Good to have skills: Data Modeling (Capable), Python (Capable), SQL (Capable)

Candidates will also document processes and provide training for users.
TechStack: Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Python
